categories.label: Organizational threat translation

comparison_trace.note: Defensive adaptation suggested a threat-response category.
Fiscal pressure added a threat-source dimension.
Earlier safety timing separated translation from simple reaction.

adequacy_gaps: Only one passage currently represents the anticipatory safety dimension.

memos.text: Safety and budget language may translate a broader sense of organizational vulnerability.

next_sampling_suggestions: Seek fictional board minutes that predate both the budget shock and relocation instruction.
methodological_limits: Category adequacy diagnostics are not saturation proof.
